census_screen.screen_target: Notebook 05 grouped out-of-fold residual; 654 modelling areas
census_screen.multiple_testing_rule: Benjamini–Hochberg: A across all retained variables; B across A candidates; adjusted p < 0.05 and same sign
census_screen.twin_rule: Absolute Spearman >= 0.98 across 654 modelling areas; retain first in table order
census_screen.model_check_rule: Add up to five individually, one per table and none within absolute Spearman 0.9 of an earlier pick; original GroupKFold assignments; complete-case baseline matched if needed; selected on these residuals
census_screen.spatial_caution: P-values assume independent areas; residual Moran's I is about 0.15; authority-halves replication is the main guard
